product.name: Monoprice Commercial Series 4x1 TV Ceiling Mount for Portrait Display Menu Boards Fits 32 to 65 TVs with Adjustable Tilt
product.description: Monoprice™Commercial Series 4×1 TV Ceiling Mount for Portrait Display Menu Boards, Fits 32" to 65" TVs with Adjustable TiltThe Monoprice Commercial Series 4×1 TV Ceiling Mount is designed for professional menu board and digital signage installations using four portrait-oriented displays. It supports 32" to 65" TVs, provides adjustable tilt for improved viewing angles, and offers a compact vertical layout optimised for portrait content. This mount is ideal for applications where vertical screen orientation maximises content density while maintaining clean alignment from a single ceiling drop.Supports four portrait-oriented displays from a single ceiling drop for space-efficient menu board layoutsFits 32" to 65" TVs for versatile commercial signage applicationsAdjustable tilt from ‑6° to +15° for optimized viewing angles based on ceiling height and audience positionCeiling drop range from 22.8 in. to 118.5 in. suits standard commercial ceiling heights.Supports 90° portrait orientation for vertical content presentation on menu boards and information displaysVertical rail system provides consistent spacing and alignment across all four screensSteel construction with concrete anchors and lag bolts for permanent ceiling installationDesigned for indoor commercial use in restaurants, retail spaces, and hospitality environments FOUR PORTRAIT DISPLAYS FROM A SINGLE CEILING DROPThe mount uses a vertical rail system engineered for a 4×1 portrait configuration, supporting four displays from a single ceiling pole assembly. This layout is intended for digital menus and information boards where vertical content presentation is preferred. ADJUSTABLE TILT FOR VIEWER READABILITYEach display interface supports fixed tilt positions up to 15°, allowing installers to adjust viewing angles based on ceiling height and audience position. COMPACT DROP RANGE FOR STANDARD COMMERCIAL CEILINGSThe ceiling pole provides an adjustable vertical drop from 22.8 in. (minimum) to 118.5 in. (maximum), making it suitable for restaurants, retail spaces, and indoor commercial environments with standard ceiling heights. PORTRAIT ORIENTATION SUPPORTThe mount supports 90° portrait orientation, ensuring proper display alignment and secure mounting for vertically oriented TVs. COMMERCIAL GRADE STEEL CONSTRUCTIONSteel construction with included concrete anchors and lag bolts supports permanent, professional installation.
